info.title: Sketa API
info.description: The REST API of Sketa, the online whiteboard for teams. It needs Sketa Plus. Authenticate with an API key from **Settings → API keys** in the `Authorization: Bearer sketa_...` header.

get.description:
The workspace the API key belongs to.

**Ability:** `workspace:read`.

patch.description:
Renames the workspace. Needs an admin's key. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `workspace:write`.

get.description:
The workspace's members with their role, oldest first.

**Ability:** `users:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

patch.description:
Changes a member's role. The owner's role cannot change. Needs an admin's key. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `users:write`.

delete.description:
Removes a member from the workspace. Their API keys and MCP connections stop working and they leave every team. With `block`, their e-mail also cannot be invited again until it is unblocked. The owner cannot be removed. Needs an admin's key. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `users:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Also block the member's e-mail (default `false`). It can also be sent in a JSON body.

get.description:
The e-mails blocked from the workspace, newest first. A blocked e-mail cannot be invited nor accept an invite. Needs an admin's key.

**Ability:** `users:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

delete.description:
Lifts a block: the e-mail can be invited again. It does not rejoin by itself. Needs an admin's key. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `users:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description:
The workspace's invites that were not accepted yet (pending or expired), newest first.

**Ability:** `invites:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

post.description:
Invites someone by e-mail with a role and sends them an invitation e-mail that expires in 3 days. Fails when the person is already a member, already has a pending invite, or their e-mail is blocked. Each member is a paid seat. Needs an admin's key.

**Ability:** `invites:write`.

patch.description:
Changes the role a pending invite grants. Accepted or expired invites cannot change.

**Ability:** `invites:write`.

delete.description:
Cancels an invite: its link stops working. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `invites:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description:
The collections the key's member can see, their private collection first, then in the manual order.

**Ability:** `collections:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

post.description:
Creates a shared collection, last in the manual order. It is visible to every member unless `team_ids` restricts it (admins only). Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `collections:write`.

emoji.description: An emoji shown before the name.

team_ids.description: Restrict the collection to these teams of the workspace.

patch.description:
Renames a collection, changes its emoji, moves it in the manual order or changes the teams it is restricted to (an empty `team_ids` opens it to every member; admins only; not for private collections). Send only the fields to change.

**Ability:** `collections:write`.

sort_order.description: The new place in the manual order.

delete.description:
Moves a shared collection and its boards to the trash, where they stay restorable from the app for 30 days. Private collections cannot be deleted.

**Ability:** `collections:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description:
The boards of a collection, most recently edited first.

**Ability:** `collections:read` and `boards:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

get.description:
The boards the key can see, most recently edited first.

**Ability:** `boards:read`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only boards whose name or canvas text matches these words.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: `true` for pinned boards only, `false` for the others.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

post.description:
Creates a board, optionally with elements. Without a `collection_id` it goes to the private collection of the key's member. Untitled boards get a name automatically.

**Ability:** `boards:write`.

collection_id.description: A collection the key can see.

elements.description: The first elements of the board, bottom first.

patch.description:
Renames a board, moves it to another collection (`collection_id`) or pins it. Send only the fields to change.

**Ability:** `boards:write`.

collection_id.description: Moves the board to this collection.

delete.description:
Moves a board to the trash, where it stays restorable from the app for 30 days.

**Ability:** `boards:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description:
The board's live elements (no deleted ones) in z-order, its content version and signed links to its image assets. This response is not wrapped in `data`.

**Ability:** `boards:read`.

put.description:
Makes the board hold exactly these elements. Each needs a `type`. Elements with the id of a live element replace it (the type cannot change); live elements left out are deleted; new elements go on top. Open editors see the change at once.

**Ability:** `boards:write`.

patch.description:
Applies patches to the board. Each patch needs an `id`: a live id merges the patch's fields into that element (the type cannot change), `{"id": "...", "isDeleted": true}` deletes it, and an unknown id with a `type` creates an element. Elements not named are left as they are. Open editors see the change at once.

**Ability:** `boards:write`.

get.description:
The workspace's audit log, newest first. Needs an admin's key.

**Ability:** `audit-logs:read`.

200.description: A page of audit log entries.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Only entries made by this user.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only entries on or after this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only entries on or before this date (not before `from`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

get.description:
The workspace's teams, by name, with their member count. Needs an admin's key.

**Ability:** `teams:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

post.description:
Creates a team, optionally with its first members. Needs an admin's key. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `teams:write`.

name.description: Unique in the workspace, ignoring case.

user_ids.description: Workspace members to put in the team.

get.description:
One team. Needs an admin's key.

**Ability:** `teams:read`.

patch.description:
Renames a team. The name stays unique, ignoring case. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `teams:write`.

delete.description:
Deletes a team. Collections restricted only to it stay restricted and become visible to the admins only. Recorded in the audit log.

**Ability:** `teams:write`.

204.description: Done. The response has no body.

get.description:
The team's members, by name, with their workspace role.

**Ability:** `teams:read`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

put.description:
Replaces the team's members with these workspace members. An empty list empties the team. People left out lose access to the collections restricted to it.

**Ability:** `teams:write`.

get.description:
The public library catalog: free shape libraries shared by the community and approved by the Sketa team, newest first. Only approved libraries are listed. The search matches every word in the name, description, author and tags, ignoring case and accents.

**Ability:** `libraries:read`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only libraries whose name, description, author or tags match these words.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to read, from 1. Each page holds `meta.per_page` items.

get.description:
One approved library of the catalog with its items and their elements. A library that is pending, rejected or removed answers 404.

**Ability:** `libraries:read`.

apiKey.description: An API key from **Settings → API keys**, starting with `sketa_`.

errors.description: The messages for each invalid field.

per_page.description: The page size. Read it instead of assuming one.

isPersonal.description: Whether this is the owner's personal workspace.

readOnly.description: Plus ended or payment failed past the grace period: nothing can be edited.

Block.description: An e-mail blocked from the workspace.

invitedBy.description: The id of the user who sent it.

isPrivate.description: A member's private collection. Only that member sees it.

isRestricted.description: Open only to the members of `teamIds` and to the admins.

sortOrder.description: Place in the manual order, from 0.

access.description: What the link gives: view shows the board to anyone; comment and edit make the signed-in person who opens it a guest of the board, and edit also lets anyone edit without an account. A slides link is always view.

createdBy.description: `null` once its creator's account is deleted.

contentVersion.description: Goes up with every content change.

previewUrl.description: A signed link to the preview image, valid for one hour.

appUrl.description: Opens the board in the app.

shareLinks.description: The board's public links: at most one readonly link and one slides link.

action.description: See the `action` filter for every value.

elements.description: Live elements in z-order, bottom first. Deleted elements are left out.

assets.description: The image assets the elements use (`id` is the image element's `fileId`), with signed links valid for one hour.

id.description: Kept when given; a new id is made otherwise.

angle.description: Radians, clockwise, around the element's center.

fontFamily.description: Font role. Top picks: hand (default), normal, code. More fonts: display, rounded, script, classic, mono. Readers treat any other value as hand.

Element.description: A board element. Missing fields get the editor's defaults and unknown fields are dropped. Every element keeps its `type` for life. The full JSON Schema is published at https://sketa.app/schemas/scene-content.v1.json.

id.description: Kept when given; a new id is made otherwise.

angle.description: Radians, clockwise, around the element's center.

fontFamily.description: Font role. Top picks: hand (default), normal, code. More fonts: display, rounded, script, classic, mono. Readers treat any other value as hand.

ElementPatch.description: A patch. With the id of a live element its fields are merged into that element (`isDeleted: true` deletes it). With an unknown id and a `type`, a new element is created.

author.description: The author name shown in the catalog.

id.description: The item id, used by the MCP `add-library-item-tool`.

elements.description: The elements the item draws, in the board content element format.

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, invalid, revoked or expired (`API key expired.`), or it belongs to a member who left the workspace (`API key revoked.`).

PlusRequired.description: The key's workspace does not have Sketa Plus.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the route's ability, the acting user is not allowed to do this, or the workspace is read-only (writes only).

example.message: This API key is missing the boards:write ability.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, is in another workspace, or is not visible to the key (for example another member's private collection).

ContentTooLarge.description: The request body is over 10 MB.

example.message: Board content is limited to 10485760 bytes.

ValidationFailed.description: The input is invalid. `errors` lists the messages per field.

TooManyRequests.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per minute per key, 600 per workspace). Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.
